The proposed $40,000,000 issuance would exceed this limit by $15,000,000. I should note that this updated limit has not yet been entered in the issuance dashboard, which is why it may not have appeared in your pre-launch data. This constraint will need to be reflected in your authorization record, and the desk will need to either reduce the issuance size to $25,000,000 or restructure the maturity profile to comply with the policy cap.

Neither the QIB-only placement restriction nor the legend requirement has been added to the proposed term sheet yet, so both will need to be incorporated before launch and documented in your authorization record.
